scientific_integrity: Published marginal crossing mean/variance and normal limit are explicitly attributed to Flajolet--Noy; the Hoeffding and Donsker mechanisms are classical. The proposed new result is the explicit length-based joint functional coupling, exact residual/projection identities, and optimally correlated short-arc threshold.
scientific_limitations: Independent chords require independently uniform endpoint angles; the shorter-arc length is dimensionless continuous geometry, not discrete rank gap. An additive projection need not equal the conditional expectation given all length variables. Weak convergence has no supplied rate; independent priority and proof validation are not performed.
title: A Brownian-bridge length law for crossings of independent uniform chords
